upheld.detail: Both branches end with `basketItems = await Basket.GetBasketItemsAsync();` (lines 149 and 154), and the valid path uses `quantity!.Value` because the compiler cannot see through IsValidQuantity. A single pattern match removes both.

upheld.detail: When the message shows, the quantity input gets neither aria-invalid nor aria-describedby pointing at the message, so a screen-reader user who returns focus to the field gets no error context. role=alert only announces the message once.

questions.title: 9999 quantity limit has no edge test and is not documented
questions.question: The fix rejects any typed quantity above 9999 per item with 'Enter a smaller quantity.'. Quantities from 10000 up to 2147483647 used to be saved and are now rejected. Is a 9999-per-item limit acceptable under 'Quantities that work today still work the same way', or should the limit be different?
